_comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment — agent-workspace. Registers the Agents page only; NO top-level menu entry, mirroring 40-automations.json's off-nav posture. Agents exist only as part of an app (reached from within the app builder), so the standalone /agents page stays routable for deep-links but is intentionally off the main nav. src/main.js mergeManifestFragments() concatenates pages onto src/manifest.json.

pages.title: Agents
pages._note: Custom page hosting the Agent Workspace (AgentsPage.vue) — Agent CRUD, per-agent chat (reusing CopilotPanel.vue scoped to that agent's agentId/enabledTools), and the transparent run-history list (AgentRunHistory.vue). type:custom because the chat panel + run-log viewer are bespoke and no built-in page type covers them.
